### Day 254: Acts 16:1–3
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-254-acts-16-13.html
Passage: Acts 16:1-3
Points:
- Timothy was young and teachable, and Paul recognized his potential rather than dismissing his youth.
- Growing up in a spiritually divided home is difficult, yet God still produced great fruit through Timothy.
- Exposure to diverse cultural and religious viewpoints gave Timothy valuable perspective that God used in ministry.
- Genuine faith modeled by parents and grandparents can outweigh negative spiritual influences in a home.
- Timothy filled a vital personal need in Paul's life as a devoted spiritual son and companion.
